records.Name: Assault Prep: Armory Keycard
records.Description: Hit a criminal hideout and grab the keycard to Balvi’s arsenal to turn his firepower into yours.

records.Name: Assault Prep: Explosives
records.Description: Disrupt a gang deal and seize the explosives—they’ll be your key to cracking the vault.

records.Name: Assault Prep: Sports Car Key
records.Description: Use Leyte, one of Balvi’s men, to plant the prototype sports cars in the hotel showroom—these beasts will be your ticket out of here.

records.Name: Final Plan: Frontal Assault
records.Description: Storm Balvi’s vault head-on with a crew you can trust—brute force trumps finesse.

records.Name: Stealth Prep: Night Vision Goggles
records.Description: Snag some night vision goggles (a stealth operator’s best friend) from Balvi’s abandoned warehouse.

records.Name: Stealth Prep: EMP Bomb
records.Description: Slip into Vault Security’s hideout and grab the EMP bomb. Use it to knock out the hotel’s security and lights, then move under the cover of darkness.

records.Name: Final Plan: Stealth Run
records.Description: Trigger a blackout with the EMP bomb, utilize the night vision for a tactical edge, then finish the job and leave without a trace.

records.Name: Stealth Prep: Acid Gun
records.Description: Track down some corrosive acid from the abandoned underground lab—it’ll silently melt through the vault door.

records.Name: Wacky Arena
records.Description: Star in a challenge-based variety show hosted by TV-Head John. Knock out the competition and win big!

records.Name: Loot Hunter · Spiko Hotel
records.Description: Star in Saturn Entertainment’s hit variety show, team up with other guests to take on the challenges, and walk away with serious cash!

records.Name: Final Plan: Party Infiltration
records.Description: Infiltrate Balvi’s lavish party while posing as a member of high society, and take him out on his big day. To outsmart IS to outgun.

records.Name: Disguise Prep: Party Invitation
records.Description: Board the luxury cruise and snag a party invite signed by Balvi himself. This will be your ticket inside.

records.Name: Disguise Prep: Modular Drill
records.Description: Disguise yourself as a Masked Malice, head deep into the gang’s camp, and locate the modular drill equipment, which will be small enough to smuggle into the party.

records.Name: Disguise Prep: Submarine
records.Description: Sneak into the deep-sea lab and secure the sub for a silent escape.

records.Name: Loot Hunter · Spiko Hotel
records.Description: Star alongside other players in Saturn Entertainment’s hit variety show, take on the challenges set by the producers, and win big!

records.Name: Darts
records.Description: Players take turns throwing darts at the board. Hitting the bullseye and inner rings grants more points. The game includes “High Score Mode” and “01 Mode,” which is randomly selected when you enter a match.

records.Name: 301 Mode
records.Description: Both players start at 301 points—hit the board to subtract from your score. First to land exactly at zero wins.

records.Name: 501 Mode
records.Description: Both players start at 501 points—hit the board to subtract from your score. First to land exactly at zero wins.

records.Name: Bowling
records.Description: Test your bowling skills against other players and score a strike on your opponents!

records.Name: Classic Match
records.Description: Black moves first. Players then alternate placing stones. The first to line up five stone in a row—either horizontally, vertically, or diagonally—wins.

records.Name: Skill Match
records.Description: Black moves first. Players then alternate placing stones. The first to line up five stones in a row—either horizontally, vertically, or diagonally—wins. Before the match begins, each player picks one special skill.
